title: China's Xi builds diplomatic clout with multiple state visits ahead of Trump summit
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to enhance his diplomatic influence through a series of state visits, starting with India. This trip marks Xi's first official visit to the country, signifying a strengthening of bilateral ties. Following his visit to India, Xi will travel to the United States for a crucial summit with President Donald Trump, where significant discussions are anticipated. These diplomatic efforts highlight China's strategic approach to international relations in the current geopolitical climate.
